name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A packaged set of habits and checklists that teaches AI coding agents to follow a disciplined software development process, instead of writing whatever code comes to mind first.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small company adopting AI coding agents who wants consistent quality and process, not one-off hacky code.
business_use_cases: A dev agency installs it across every client project so AI-written features follow the same test-first, review-before-merge discipline.
A solo founder without a technical co-founder uses it as a built-in 'senior engineer' process so their AI-written app doesn't collapse under its own bugs.
A coding bootcamp licenses a customized version as a best-practices overlay for students pairing with AI coding tools.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a maintained 'team edition' fork with company-specific policy packs (security review, compliance checklists) sold to companies standardizing on AI-assisted development.

steal_this: Package the methodology into an onboarding checklist for teams adopting Claude Code or Cursor at work, sold as a one-time team license this weekend.
